newsitem.title: USA: Schick Technologies IPO range increased.
newsitem.headline: Schick Technologies IPO range increased.

text.p: Schick Technologies Inc has increased the price to buy shares in its initial public offering, due to price Monday for trading Tuesday.

According to lead underwriter Lehman Brothers, the 1.75 million shares will sell for between $17 and $19. When the company first filed to go public in May, it estimated shares would price between $15 and $17 each.
The Long Island City, N.Y. company makes digital radiography devices used in dental X-ray computer imaging systems. The shares are due to trade on Nasdaq under the symbol "SCHK".
